text: OWNER DECISIONS 2026-09-30 (in chat, made from the declaration text only; I have not seen the sealed heavy log and it was not relayed). (1) Bound = Adopt restricted to S. Per candidate: Adopt if all 12 cells meet the Adopt criteria. Else Bound(S) for S in {n>=20, nu>=40} if every confirmation cell in S passes null and failure, Gain holds in >=1 power cell in S, and Non-loss holds in every power cell in S; Fails outside S are allowed; if both S qualify, the domain is their union. Else Decline (any Fail or Definite loss). Else Unresolved. (2) Selection of the 6 data-chosen cells: score = max over the 3 candidates of (null rejections + study failures)/R; pool = the 90 core cells minus the 6 fixed; ties go to the lexicographically lowest ID string; the selection is disclosed. (3) In the known-v/frozen-tau2 control, u* is drawn from the restricted tau0-hat^2. (4) Freeze cells.json 76e6785b unchanged, ratifying the stress-cell choices; the heavy log is sealed; manifest v2 is hash-chained to 76e6785b and binds the selection rule, the decision rule and the harness source sha256s; the pilot runs only after the F2-F4 fixes land and are re-reviewed.
